functions.description: Convert the nominal annual interest rate percentage into a periodic interest rate per compounding period.
inputs: the nominal annual interest rate as a percentage
the compounding frequency of the interest per year
outputs: the periodic interest rate per compounding period

functions.description: Compute the total number of payment periods from the loan term in years and the compounding frequency per year.
inputs: the compounding frequency of the interest per year
outputs: the total number of payment periods

functions.description: Evaluate the natural logarithm of one plus a small periodic interest rate by series expansion.
inputs: the periodic interest rate per compounding period
outputs: the natural logarithm of one plus the periodic rate

functions.description: Compute the compound growth factor (1+r)^n for a periodic rate r and a number of periods n.
inputs: the periodic interest rate per compounding period
the total number of payment periods

functions.description: Compute the fixed periodic payment of an amortizing loan from the principal, the periodic interest rate and the compound growth factor.
inputs: the principal amount of the loan with currency unit
the periodic interest rate per compounding period

functions.description: Compute the total interest paid over the life of a loan from the periodic payment, the number of payments and the principal.
inputs: the total number of payment periods
the principal amount of the loan with currency unit
outputs: the total interest paid over the life of the loan

functions.description: Round a monetary amount to the nearest cent for reporting.
inputs: the monetary amount to be rounded
outputs: the rounded monetary amount in dollars and cents

functions.description: Compute the monthly payment and total interest of a fixed-rate amortizing mortgage from principal, nominal annual rate, compounding frequency and loan term by chaining the registered loan steps.
inputs: the principal amount of the loan with currency unit
the nominal annual interest rate as a percentage
the compounding frequency of the interest per year
outputs: the total interest paid over the life of the loan

entry_points.text: A ●1 mortgage has a ●2 annual interest rate, compounded ●3, over ●4. What is the monthly payment, and how much total interest is paid over the life of the loan?

params.description: the principal amount of the loan with currency unit
params.validity_range: Must be a strictly positive monetary amount; a zero or negative principal does not describe a meaningful loan.

params.description: the nominal annual interest rate as a percentage
params.validity_range: Non-negative in practice; a zero rate reduces the payment to principal divided by the number of periods, and the periodic rate must satisfy 1 + r > 0. Realistic mortgage rates lie roughly between 0% and 30%.

params.description: the compounding frequency of the interest per year
params.validity_range: Must correspond to a positive integer number of compounding periods per year, such as 1 (annually), 2 (semi-annually), 4 (quarterly), 12 (monthly), 26 or 52 (weekly variants), or 365 (daily).
Must be strictly positive; the total number of payments n = years × periods per year must be a positive integer for the standard fixed-payment schedule to apply.
